top_stories.title: Google Launches Gemini AI App on Mac [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: Google has released a dedicated Gemini AI application for Mac, expanding the assistant's native desktop presence beyond its existing web and mobile platforms. The launch brings Gemini's capabilities directly to macOS users as competition among AI assistant apps intensifies.

top_stories.title: Chrome Now Lets You Turn AI Prompts into Repeatable 'Skills'
top_stories.summary: Google has launched a new feature in Chrome that allows users to save their best AI prompts as one-click 'Skills', making frequently used AI-powered actions reusable across browsing sessions. The feature integrates Gemini directly into the browser workflow, aiming to streamline repetitive tasks.

top_stories.title: Making Business Apps Smarter with AI, Copilot, and Agents in Power Apps
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has outlined new capabilities bringing AI, Copilot, and autonomous agents into Power Apps, enabling businesses to build smarter applications without deep coding expertise. The update reflects Microsoft's broader push to embed AI assistance throughout its enterprise software stack.

top_stories.title: AI Could Democratize One of Tech's Most Valuable Resources
top_stories.summary: Wired reports on how AI tools are beginning to open up access to resources and capabilities that were previously restricted to well-funded technology companies, potentially levelling the playing field for smaller organisations and individuals. The piece examines which specific resources are becoming more accessible and what that shift could mean for competition in tech.

top_stories.title: The Attacks on Sam Altman Are a Warning for the AI World
top_stories.summary: The Verge examines the broader significance of physical threats and attacks targeting OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, framing them as a warning signal about the personal risks facing leaders in the AI industry as public anxiety around the technology grows. The piece discusses what increased hostility toward AI figures could mean for the sector.

further_links.title: Study: Back-to-Basics Approach Can Match or Outperform AI in Language Analysis
further_links.summary: University of Manchester research finds that traditional statistical methods can match or outperform AI models in certain language analysis tasks, raising questions about the automatic assumption that AI is always the superior tool.

further_links.title: Grok's Sexual Deepfakes Almost Got It Banned from Apple's App Store. Almost. [Paywalled]
further_links.summary: xAI's Grok chatbot came close to removal from Apple's App Store after it was found generating sexual deepfake images, highlighting ongoing content policy challenges for AI platforms on major app marketplaces.

further_links.title: Redefining the Future of Software Engineering
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review explores how AI is reshaping the software engineering profession, examining what skills will matter most as AI-assisted coding tools become standard practice.

further_links.title: Amazon AI Cancelling Webcomics
further_links.summary: Amazon's AI systems are reportedly flagging and cancelling webcomic content, raising concerns among creators about automated content moderation affecting creative work.

further_links.title: Allbirds Announces Pivot from Shoes to AI Compute Infrastructure
further_links.summary: Footwear brand Allbirds announced a dramatic pivot to AI compute infrastructure, causing its stock to surge dramatically — a move that drew widespread scrutiny and scepticism about the substance behind the announcement.

further_links.title: Building Trust in the AI Era with Privacy-Led UX
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines how product designers and AI developers can build user trust by embedding privacy-centred principles into AI user experience design.

further_links.title: How to Use Google Chrome's New AI-Powered 'Skills'
further_links.summary: Wired provides a practical guide to Google Chrome's newly launched AI Skills feature, which lets users convert saved prompts into repeatable one-click tools within the browser.

further_links.title: No One's Sure If Synthetic Mirror Life Will Kill Us All
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review investigates the emerging science of synthetic mirror-image microbes and the profound uncertainty — including existential risk concerns — surrounding this frontier of biotechnology.

further_links.title: Anthropic's Claude AI Now Powers Advanced Business Applications
further_links.summary: A roundup of how Anthropic's Claude is being deployed across a range of advanced enterprise and business applications, reflecting the model's growing commercial footprint.
